notes: I found no mandatory issues. The port is byte-faithful: 10 paths match the approved delta exactly, and the merge is reproducible with both semantics intact. The T2 regression now runs only in the native profile, as main decided, so hosted CI does not exercise it; it remains local evidence of the native profile. b6-0241 is heavy (spawn timeout 600 s, I1 test 300 s) and enters the default collection, so CI must have Node 22.23.2 with the pinned sha, just as b6-0236-semantic-engine already requires. Under the read-only scope, I ran no tests, so this is static analysis only. The only file I wrote was the temporary merge output in the session scratchpad (critic-r1/).
